title_en: Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Financing Guarantee Companies

articles.content_en: These Regulations are formulated for the purposes of supporting the development of inclusive finance, promoting financing, regulating the conduct of financing guarantee companies, and preventing risks.

For the purposes of these Regulations, "financing guarantee" refers to the act of a guarantor providing guarantee for debt financing such as borrowing or bond issuance of the guaranteed party; "financing guarantee company" refers to a limited liability company or joint stock company limited established according to law that engages in financing guarantee business.

A financing guarantee company shall, in carrying out its business, comply with laws and regulations, operate prudently, be trustworthy, and shall not harm the national interest, public interest, or the legitimate rights and interests of others.

The department designated by the people's government of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government (hereinafter referred to as the regulatory department) shall be responsible for the supervision and administration of financing guarantee companies within its region.
The people's government of a province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government shall be responsible for formulating policies and measures to promote the development of the financing guarantee industry in its region, handling risks of financing guarantee companies, and urging the regulatory department to strictly perform its duties.
The State Council shall establish an inter-ministerial joint conference for the regulation of financing guarantee business, which shall be responsible for drafting the supervision and administration system for financing guarantee companies, coordinating and resolving major issues in the supervision and administration of financing guarantee companies, and urging and guiding local people's governments in the supervision and administration and risk disposal of financing guarantee companies. The inter-ministerial joint conference for the regulation of financing guarantee business shall be led by the banking regulatory authority under the State Council, with relevant departments of the State Council participating.

The State shall promote the establishment of a government-led financing guarantee system, develop financing guarantee companies supported by the government, and establish a cooperation mechanism among the government, banking financial institutions, and financing guarantee companies, to expand the scale of financing guarantee services provided to small and micro enterprises, agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, and maintain a relatively low fee level.
The finance departments of people's governments at all levels shall provide financial support to financing guarantee companies that primarily serve small and micro enterprises, agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, through capital injection, establishment of risk-sharing mechanisms, and other means. The specific measures shall be formulated by the finance department of the State Council.

The establishment of a financing guarantee company shall be subject to the approval of the regulatory department.
The name of a financing guarantee company shall clearly indicate the words "financing guarantee".
Without the approval of the regulatory department, no unit or individual shall engage in financing guarantee business, and no unit shall use the words "financing guarantee" in its name, unless otherwise provided by the State.

An applicant applying for the establishment of a financing guarantee company shall submit to the regulatory department a written application and materials proving that it meets the conditions prescribed in Article 7 of these Regulations.
The regulatory department shall, within 30 days from the date of accepting the application, make a decision of approval or disapproval. If the decision is to approve, it shall issue a financing guarantee business permit; if the decision is disapproval, it shall notify the applicant in writing and state the reasons.
A financing guarantee company established with approval shall be announced by the regulatory department.

A financing guarantee company shall obtain the approval of the regulatory department for merger, division, or reduction of registered capital.
If a financing guarantee company establishes a branch within the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government where its domicile is located, changes its name, changes a shareholder holding more than 5% of the equity, or changes directors, supervisors, or senior officers, it shall file for record with the regulatory department within 30 days from the date of establishment of the branch or from the date of change of the relevant matters; the changed matters shall comply with the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 6 and Article 7 of these Regulations.

A financing guarantee company that establishes a branch across provinces, autonomous regions, or municipalities directly under the Central Government shall meet the following conditions and obtain the approval of the regulatory department of the place where the proposed branch is to be located:
(1) The registered capital shall not be less than RMB 1 billion yuan;
(2) It has been engaged in financing guarantee business for more than three years and has been profitable for the last two consecutive accounting years;
(3) There is no record of material illegal or non-compliant conduct in the most recent two years.
The procedures and time limit for the examination and approval by the regulatory department of the place where the proposed branch is to be located shall be governed by the provisions of Article 8 of these Regulations.
A financing guarantee company shall, within 30 days from the date of establishment of the branch, report the relevant information to the regulatory department of the place where its domicile is located.
The routine supervision and administration of a branch established by a financing guarantee company across provinces, autonomous regions, or municipalities directly under the Central Government shall be the responsibility of the regulatory department of the place where the branch is located, and the regulatory department of the place where the financing guarantee company's domicile is located shall cooperate.

Where a financing guarantee company is dissolved, it shall establish a liquidation group according to law to carry out liquidation and make clear arrangements for the undertaking of unmatured financing guarantee liabilities. The liquidation process shall be subject to the supervision of the regulatory department.
Where a financing guarantee company is dissolved or is declared bankrupt according to law, it shall surrender the financing guarantee business permit to the regulatory department for cancellation, and the regulatory department shall make an announcement.

In addition to engaging in financing guarantee business such as loan guarantee and bond issuance guarantee, a financing guarantee company with sound operation and good financial condition may also engage in non-financing guarantee businesses such as bid guarantee, project performance guarantee, and litigation preservation guarantee, as well as service businesses such as consulting related to guarantee business.

A financing guarantee company shall, in accordance with the principle of prudent operation, establish and improve business standards for financing guarantee project evaluation, post-guarantee management, recovery of compensation liabilities, and other aspects, as well as internal control systems such as risk management.
A financing guarantee company supported by the government shall enhance its ability to utilize modern information technology means such as big data, to serve the financing needs of small and micro enterprises, agriculture, rural areas, and farmers.
A financing guarantee company shall measure the balance of guarantee liabilities in accordance with the risk weights prescribed by the State.

The balance of guarantee liabilities of a financing guarantee company shall not exceed 10 times its net assets.
For a financing guarantee company that primarily serves small and micro enterprises, agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, the cap on the multiple prescribed in the preceding paragraph may be increased to 15 times.

The ratio of the balance of guarantee liabilities of a financing guarantee company for the same guaranteed party to its net assets shall not exceed 10%, and the ratio of the balance of guarantee liabilities for the same guaranteed party and its related parties to its net assets shall not exceed 15%.

A financing guarantee company shall not provide financing guarantee for its controlling shareholder or de facto controller, and the conditions for providing financing guarantee for other related parties shall not be more favorable than the conditions for providing similar guarantee for non-related parties.
Where a financing guarantee company provides financing guarantee for a related party, it shall report to the regulatory department within 30 days from the date of providing the guarantee, and disclose it in the notes to the accounting statements.
A financing guarantee company shall set aside corresponding provisions in accordance with the relevant provisions of the State.

The financing guarantee fee rate shall be determined through negotiation between the financing guarantee company and the guaranteed party.
A financing guarantee company that is included in the financing guarantee risk-sharing mechanism established by the government shall, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the State, lower the financing guarantee fee rate for small and micro enterprises, agriculture, rural areas, and farmers.

Where the guaranteed party or a third party provides counter-guarantee to a financing guarantee company by way of mortgage or pledge, and registration is required according to law, the relevant registration authority shall handle the registration according to law.

A financing guarantee company shall have the right to request the guaranteed party to provide information on business activities and financial status related to the financing guarantee.
A financing guarantee company shall provide to the creditors of the guaranteed party information on business activities and financial status related to the financing guarantee.
The utilization of a financing guarantee company's own funds shall comply with the provisions of the State concerning the safety and liquidity of assets of financing guarantee companies.

The regulatory department shall establish and improve the supervision and administration work system, use modern information technology means such as big data to monitor risks in real time, strengthen off-site supervision and on-site inspection of financing guarantee companies, and establish supervision and administration coordination mechanisms and information sharing mechanisms with relevant departments.

The regulatory department shall implement categorized supervision and administration of financing guarantee companies based on factors such as their business scale, main service targets, internal management level, and risk status.

The regulatory department shall, in accordance with the requirements of the State's statistical system for financing guarantees, submit statistical data on financing guarantee companies in its region to the people's government at the corresponding level and the banking regulatory authority under the State Council.

The regulatory department shall analyze and evaluate the development of the financing guarantee industry and the supervision and administration situation in its region, report annually to the people's government at the corresponding level and the banking regulatory authority under the State Council, and make it public to the society.

The regulatory department may, as required for performing its duties, conduct supervision and administration talks with the directors, supervisors, and senior officers of a financing guarantee company, and request them to make explanations on major matters concerning the business activities and risk management of the financing guarantee company.
The regulatory department may notify the creditors of the guaranteed party of the illegal or non-compliant conduct or risk situation of the financing guarantee company.

A financing guarantee company shall, as required, submit to the regulatory department documents and materials such as business reports, financial reports, and annual audit reports issued by certified public accountants.
Where a financing guarantee company conducts business across provinces, autonomous regions, or municipalities directly under the Central Government, it shall report quarterly to the regulatory department of the place of its domicile and the regulatory department of the place where the business is conducted on the status of business operations.
A financing guarantee company shall cooperate with the regulatory department in the supervision and inspection conducted according to law, and shall not refuse or obstruct.

The regulatory department shall establish and improve a credit record system for financing guarantee companies. The credit records of financing guarantee companies shall be incorporated into the national credit information sharing platform.

The regulatory department shall, together with relevant departments, establish mechanisms for early warning, prevention, and handling of material risk events of financing guarantee companies, and formulate contingency plans for material risk events of financing guarantee companies.
Where a financing guarantee company experiences a material risk event, it shall immediately take emergency measures and promptly report to the regulatory department. The regulatory department shall promptly handle the situation and report to the people's government at the corresponding level, the banking regulatory authority under the State Council, and the People's Bank of China.
The regulatory department and its staff shall keep confidential the trade secrets learned during supervision and administration work.

Where, in violation of these Regulations, a financing guarantee company is established or financing guarantee business is operated without approval, the regulatory department shall ban it or order it to cease operations, impose a fine of not less than RMB 500,000 yuan but not more than RMB 1 million yuan, and confiscate any illegal gains; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.
Where, in violation of these Regulations, the words "financing guarantee" are used in the name without approval, the regulatory department shall order rectification within a specified time limit; if rectification is not made within the time limit, a fine of not less than RMB 50,000 yuan but not more than RMB 100,000 yuan shall be imposed, and any illegal gains shall be confiscated.

Where a financing guarantee company changes relevant matters without filing for record in accordance with these Regulations, or the changed matters do not comply with the provisions of these Regulations, the regulatory department shall order rectification within a specified time limit; if rectification is not made within the time limit, a fine of not less than RMB 50,000 yuan but not more than RMB 100,000 yuan shall be imposed, and if the circumstances are serious, it shall order suspension of business for rectification.

Where a financing guarantee company makes entrusted investments, the regulatory department shall order rectification within a specified time limit, impose a fine of not less than RMB 500,000 yuan but not more than RMB 1 million yuan, and confiscate any illegal gains; if rectification is not made within the time limit, it shall order suspension of business for rectification, and if the circumstances are serious, revoke its financing guarantee business permit.
Where a financing guarantee company absorbs public deposits or absorbs deposits in disguised form, or engages in proprietary loans or entrusted loans, it shall be punished in accordance with relevant laws and administrative regulations.

Where a financing guarantee company fails to submit documents and materials such as business reports, financial reports, annual audit reports, or the status of business operations to the regulatory department as required, or fails to report the material risk events it experiences, the regulatory department shall order rectification within a specified time limit and impose a fine of not less than RMB 50,000 yuan but not more than RMB 200,000 yuan; if rectification is not made within the time limit, it shall order suspension of business for rectification; if the circumstances are serious, revoke its financing guarantee business permit.

Where a fine is imposed on a financing guarantee company in accordance with these Regulations, depending on the specific circumstances, a fine of not more than RMB 50,000 yuan may also be imposed on the directors, supervisors, and senior officers directly responsible.
Where a financing guarantee company violates these Regulations and the circumstances are serious, the regulatory department may prohibit the directors, supervisors, and senior officers directly responsible from serving as directors, supervisors, or senior officers of a financing guarantee company for a specified period or for life.

Where a staff member of the regulatory department abuses power, neglects duties, or engages in irregularities for personal gain in the supervision and administration of financing guarantee companies, he or she shall be given disciplinary sanctions according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Financing guarantee industry organizations shall, in accordance with laws, regulations, and their articles of association, play a role in service, coordination, and industry self-discipline, and guide financing guarantee companies to operate according to law and compete fairly.

Where government funds or government departments directly establish and operate institutions to conduct financing guarantee business for the purpose of promoting employment and entrepreneurship, the relevant provisions of the State shall apply.
Rural mutual-aid financing guarantee organizations conducting guarantee business and forest management entities carrying out forest rights acquisition and storage guarantee business shall not be subject to these Regulations.

The measures for the administration of financing re-guarantee companies shall be separately formulated by the banking regulatory authority under the State Council together with the relevant departments of the State Council, and shall be submitted to the State Council for approval.

A financing guarantee company established before these Regulations come into force that does not meet the conditions prescribed in these Regulations shall meet the conditions prescribed in these Regulations within the time limit prescribed by the regulatory department; if it still fails to meet the conditions after the time limit expires, it shall not conduct any new financing guarantee business.
These Regulations shall come into force as of October 1, 2017.
